title: JSFL gaps: doc.addNewSymbol, library.items linkageClassName/scalingGrid, fl.uuid, fl.documentHasUnsavedChanges, fl.showIdleMessage
description:
Add missing JSFL surface to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:
1. doc.addNewSymbol(name, type): convenience wrapper calling library.addNewItem(type, name) and returning the item proxy.
2. library.items[n].linkageClassName: expose as a direct readable property on JsflLibraryItem (currently only available via getItemProperty('className')). Add to JsflLibraryItem interface and makeLibraryProxy items array.
3. library.items[n].scalingGrid: expose Symbol.scale9Grid as a readable property on JsflLibraryItem: { left, top, right, bottom } or null.
4. doc.uuid / fl.getDocumentDOM().uuid: add a uuid getter on JsflDocument returning state.doc.id.
5. fl.documentHasUnsavedChanges(): stub returning false.
6. fl.showIdleMessage(show): console.warn stub.
